events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since we lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legend whose voice and stage presence changed music forever. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles: Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: 51 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh today as it did in '65.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who passed away in 1980 and would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, a true visionary whose music and message continue to inspire. His legacy lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have marked his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music and culture is truly immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: 92 years since the birth of Elvis Presley. His music still shakes up the airwaves like no other.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the one and only Jimmy Page. His riffs are still setting the standard.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary British singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Rod Stewart, turning 82 today. Still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the iconic Suggs! Forever the face of Madness and a true British legend.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that smooth, soulful voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! An absolute legend in every sense.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That lead singer and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: A True Pop Star
angles.copy: Wishing Gary Barlow a very happy 56th birthday! From Take That anthems to solo hits, a true pop icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul and R&B singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' making us want to dance.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Who Was First?
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inducted its first class. Who would be in your inaugural lineup?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Forever a Pop Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still bringing the pop magic.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles took to the roof for their final gig. An unforgettable moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo superstar Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Simply British
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-com king to versatile actor, a true British icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Bringing SexyBack
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! Still crushing it in music, film, and style.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97) in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, rock and roll lost three of its brightest stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: "Never Gonna Give You Up" singer Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still got the moves and the voice.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of peace and unity lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since we lost the incomparable Whitney Houston, who would have been 64.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the powerhouse voice of Whitney Houston, 15 years on. Her music continues to move generations.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop sensation Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: A Day of Tears
angles.copy: Remember the day Take That first split? 31 years ago, pop fans everywhere shed a tear. Good thing they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell! Still bringing those reggae vibes from UB40.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Shape Of You
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! Still dominating the charts and our playlists.
